memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them, then you may be sure that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the Lord your God has given you." — Josh 23:12-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua now speaks a solemn warning. If Israel turns away and binds itself to the surrounding nations — through alliances and intermarriage that would draw their hearts toward foreign gods — the blessing would turn to grief. The nations they refused to separate from would become "snares and traps," "whips" and "thorns."

We must read this carefully. The concern was never about ethnicity or nationality; it was about the heart. God knew that close ties with those who served idols would slowly pull Israel's affections away from Him. The real danger was spiritual compromise — a divided heart.

This is honest and sobering. Sin that we refuse to deal with does not stay contained. What we tolerate today can entangle us tomorrow. The very things we make peace with instead of putting away can become thorns in our eyes.

The New Testament carries the same wisdom. Bad company corrupts good character (1 Cor 15:33), and believers are warned not to be bound together in ways that pull them from Christ (2 Cor 6:14). This is not a call to look down on others, but to guard our own hearts about who and what we let shape us. Whom do you allow to influence your walk with God? Deal honestly with anything that quietly turns your heart from the Lord, before it becomes a thorn.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are there influences in your life slowly pulling your heart from God?
2. What sin or compromise might you be tolerating instead of removing?
3. Who shapes your walk with God — and is it for good or for ill?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, show me anything I am tolerating that pulls my heart from You. Give me courage to deal with it honestly, so it never becomes a thorn in my life. Amen.
